key_patterns: Presenter: core/assistant-message/presentAssistantMessage.ts executeAssistantMessageBlock has per-case pushToolResult (hasToolResult guard), handleError(action, Error) (say error + toolError result, ignores AskIgnoredError), and toTelemetryToolName(name, isCustomTool, experiments) for telemetry keys (never the raw name). Task.pushToolResultToUserContent dedupes on tool_use_id. Task.presentAssistantMessageSafe filters rejections whose message ends with 'aborted'. Retry loops in Task.ts: attemptApiRequest first-chunk catch (~5138) recurses via yield* this.attemptApiRequest(retryAttempt + 1); the mid-stream catch in recursivelyMakeClineRequests (~3853) pushes the stack with retryAttempt + 1; the empty-assistant path is ~4276-4355. Abort: abortTask() aborts lifetimeController synchronously, sets abort, and is idempotent via abortPromise. Task spec patterns: core/task/__tests__/Task.spec.ts (typed TaskTestAccess + getTaskTestAccess, real ClineProvider, vi.spyOn(task.api, 'createMessage'), getSystemPrompt stubbed, stubModelInfo, asyncStreamFrom from src/test-utils/stream.ts) for tests that need the real attemptApiRequest. core/task/__tests__/Task.abort-reason-race.spec.ts (makeMockProvider plain object, task['attemptApiRequest'] = async function*, i18n mocked to key) for lightweight loop tests. Presenter spec pattern: presentAssistantMessage-custom-tool.spec.ts mock preamble (vi.mock Task, validateToolUse/isValidToolName, @roo-code/core customToolRegistry, telemetry). Real-loop Task specs use real timers with api/providers/utils/timeout-config mocked to tiny ms values (Task awaits setImmediate, which fake timers would stall). Pure units use vi.useFakeTimers.
